tagline: Leading apartment communities operator in premier U.S. markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Principal driver of operating performance in residential real estate: reflects organic growth of net rental income in stabilized assets, the core of the business model.

kpis.name: Same Store NOI
kpis.explanation: Net operating income from stabilized properties held for at least one year, compared year-over-year.
kpis.description: Same Store NOI increased by 1.9% in 2025, driven by a 2.5% rise in rental revenues, partially offset by a 3.8% increase in operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Modest organic growth: rental income gains partially offset by rising operating costs.

kpis.name: Total Net Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Total net operating income from all properties after deduction of operating expenses.
kpis.description: Total NOI primarily follows Same Store NOI as it is the main performance indicator for stabilized property operations.
kpis.signal: Stable operating performance driven by existing assets and portfolio growth.

kpis.name: Net Income Attributable
kpis.explanation: Net income after expenses, interest, and taxes, available to common shareholders.
kpis.description: Net income declined by 2.8% in 2025 ($1,051.3M vs $1,082.0M in 2024) due to higher depreciation expense of $913.4M, increased net interest expenses, and lower gains on real estate dispositions.
kpis.signal: Slight decline due to higher depreciation, interest expenses, and reduced gains on property sales.

kpis.name: Development Starts
kpis.explanation: Number of apartments commenced in construction during the year.
kpis.description: In 2025, the company started construction on 11 new communities and expanded 2 existing projects, totaling 3,888 units with an estimated capitalized cost of $1,636M.
kpis.signal: Active portfolio expansion: 11 new projects started and 2 existing projects expanded.

kpis.name: Property Acquisitions
kpis.explanation: Number of units acquired during the year.
kpis.description: In 2025, the company acquired 12 properties totaling 3,378 apartments for $826.0M, including the acquisition of the 50% partner interest in a joint venture.
kpis.signal: Active acquisition strategy to strengthen the portfolio and align assets with market dynamics.

kpis.name: Property Dispositions
kpis.explanation: Number of units sold during the year.
kpis.description: In 2025, the company sold 9 properties totaling 2,102 apartments and 38,000 square feet of commercial space for $811.7M.
kpis.signal: Active portfolio rotation to realize gains and redeploy capital.

kpis.name: Total Communities
kpis.explanation: Total number of properties owned or held through joint ventures, including those under construction.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, the company owned or held an interest in 320 communities totaling 98,694 units, including 24 under construction across 11 states and the District of Columbia.
kpis.signal: Diversified portfolio across 11 states with strong presence in major metropolitan areas.

kpis.name: Total Apartment Homes
kpis.explanation: Total number of units in consolidated and unconsolidated portfolio.
kpis.description: The total portfolio includes 98,694 units across 320 communities, including 24 under construction and 8 held by unconsolidated entities.
kpis.signal: Significant scale of rental portfolio providing substantial operational leverage.

kpis.name: Same Store NOI
kpis.explanation: Net operating income from stabilized properties held for at least one year, compared year-over-year.
kpis.description: Same Store NOI increased by 1.9% in 2025 to $1,860.4M, driven by a 2.5% rise in rental revenues, partially offset by a 3.8% increase in operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Modest organic growth: rental income gains offset by controlled cost increases.

kpis.name: Net Income Attributable
kpis.explanation: Net income after expenses, interest, and taxes, available to common shareholders.
kpis.description: Net income declined by 2.8% in 2025 to $1,051.3M due to higher depreciation ($913.4M), interest expenses, and lower gains on real estate dispositions ($335.7M).
kpis.signal: Slight decline impacted by financing and depreciation costs despite NOI growth.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid in dividends per share over the fiscal year. Key indicator for income-oriented investors.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Annual total of cash returned to shareholders: dividends paid + share buybacks (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Share of net income distributed as dividends. Above 80% indicates a potentially unsustainable dividend.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

risks.title: Risks related to real estate development and construction
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned early (Item 1A) and detailed with numerous sub-risks (costs, delays, permits, quality). The language is strong, highlighting potentially severe impacts on profitability and the loss of opportunities. Development is a core business activity.

risks.title: Risks related to acquisitions and expansion into new markets
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly identified and detailed, covering underperformance of acquisitions and challenges adapting to new markets. The company uses strong language to describe potential impacts on profitability. Expansion is a key strategy.

risks.title: Risks related to dependence on third-party developers and contractors
risks.score_rationale: This risk is specifically mentioned in the context of expansion into new markets, highlighting increased reliance. The language indicates risks of underperformance, contract breaches, or liquidity constraints among these third parties.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence or machine learning in the company AVB's 10-K/20-F report.
